final: WITH order_rates AS (SELECT o.recordvault, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) - AVG(f.rebrate) AS net_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY o.recordvault, u.acctscope), scope_rates AS (SELECT acctscope, AVG(net_rate) AS average_net_fee_rate, COUNT(net_rate) AS order_count FROM order_rates WHERE net_rate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY acctscope) SELECT acctscope, average_net_fee_rate, order_count, average_net_fee_rate - (SELECT AVG(average_net_fee_rate) FROM scope_rates) AS difference_from_scope_average FROM scope_rates
